blocks.text: You can use this app to analyze the billing and invoicing process for all billing and invoicing statuses and KPIs. You can drill down to a lower level (such as involved contract IDs) and see all relevant analytical information for the respective data at a highly detailed level. Aggregated information (such as the number of contracts that are ready for invoicing) is also available.
This app is available for the role Billing Specialist (Utilities) ( SAP_BR_BILLING_SPECIALIST_ISU ).

The app presents the most relevant KPIs for a portion-centered analysis of the billing and invoicing process. You can use different charts to perform a step-by-step analysis of data from different perspectives. You can use a table-based approach to access transactional content. The chart and table visualizations can also be used to perform a comprehensive analysis and to drill down through either the chart or table entries to obtain detailed object information.

- Filter the result set using criteria such as:
  - Portion (mandatory)
  - Scheduled Billing Date (mandatory)
  - Contract Account
  - Business Partner (a navigation to the business partner overview is available here. In the graphic, select the icon ‘Chart & Table View’, expand the table details, and choose ‘Business Partner’ in the settings)
- Use visual filters to directly see the impact of your filter settings in a chart. The visual filter offers a unique way of filtering large data sets using visualizations. This helps to recognize facts and situations, whilst reducing the number of interaction steps needed to gain insights. Visual filters are available for the following KPIs:
  - Invoicing Progress
  - Invoicing Status
  - Billing Progress
  - Billing Status
- You can make settings to apply specific user configurations to your visualizations, such as sorting, grouping and selecting columns in your table view. Examples of available fields are:
  - Scheduled Billing Date
  - Invoicing Progress
  - Billing Progress
  - Contract
  - Rate Category
The relevant business catalog for this app is Utilities Billing ( SAP_ISU_BC_BIL_SPECIALIST ).
